post.title: Refunded way too much? That's your own money.
post.ig:
Refunded $4,950 too much? That's your own money.
The scam: a fake support agent offers a $50 refund and asks for remote access to your computer.
Your bank suddenly shows $5,000. They beg for $4,950 back, often in gift cards.
Per the FTC, they just moved your own money (say, savings to checking) or faked the screen.
Tech support scam losses reported to the FBI hit $2.1B in 2025, about 6x 2021.
Sources: FTC consumer alerts; FBI IC3 Internet Crime Reports 2021-2025.
